questions.text: A particle moves in a circle of radius 20 cm with a linear speed of 10 m/s. What is its centripetal acceleration?
questions.explanation: Centripetal acceleration a = v² / r = (10 m/s)² / (0.20 m) = 100 / 0.20 = 500 m/s².

questions.text: What is the dimensional formula for Planck's constant (h)?
questions.explanation: E = hν => h = E / ν = [M L² T⁻²] / [T⁻¹] = [M L² T⁻¹].

questions.text: What is the oxidation state of Chromium in K₂Cr₂O₇?
Which among the following has the highest boiling point?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen Fluoride (HF) forms extensive intermolecular hydrogen bonds, leading to an abnormally high boiling point compared to other hydrogen halides.

questions.text: If f(x) = ln(sin(x)), what is f'(x)?
questions.explanation: By chain rule, f'(x) = (1 / sin(x)) · cos(x) = cot(x).

questions.text: What is the value of ∫ (from 0 to π/2) sin²(x) dx?
questions.explanation: Using standard definite integral properties: ∫ (0 to π/2) sin²(x) dx = (1/2) · (π/2) = π/4.
